When you approve a task you can pick the day it was really completed. Late days count only up to that day. You can also change the date later on an approved task.|Yearly incentive has a title you set (Edit amount, Title). Engineers see it.|Incentives show the rupees lost on each card, late task and month.|Project incentives need a title and list their tasks. Every incentive card has Edit and Delete for Admin.

Incentives now show the rupees lost: on each card, each late task and each month.|Project incentives need a title and list the project's tasks with their status (on time, late, waiting for approval).|Every incentive card has Edit and Delete buttons for Admin, including earned and not achieved ones. Delete asks first and is recorded.

Admin can edit each engineer's incentive amount any time from Incentives (Edit amount).|New project incentives: set a separate incentive for an engineer on one project. Only tasks of that project move its bar, 1 point per late day until you approve.|Old green and red points system removed. Pay shows only the incentive bar.

Early check-in is now automatic. Check in before 09:30 and it is recorded as early with your real time, and overtime counts from it. Check-in opens at 04:00.|Incentive is set for each engineer by Admin (Engineers, Edit). Each point is 1/100 of that amount.|A task keeps costing 1 point a day after its deadline until Admin approves it as complete.

Incentive bar now on your home screen. It starts at 100: 1 point lost per day a task runs late and per loss-of-pay absence. Each point is worth Rs 250 of the Rs 25,000 incentive. Earlier delayed tasks are counted.|Firebase limit warning for Admin. Fewer Firebase reads. Fixed top strip with clock and version.

Admin sees a red warning at once if Firebase stops the app (daily free limit used up).|Fewer Firebase reads: the clock check runs rarely, which protects the free daily limit.|A solid strip at the top stays fixed over the status bar area: app clock in the centre, version at the right.|Review log now names the person, day, update and old and new decision. Time deductions under Rs 20 are skipped.
